constraints: compressed's returned value is one of the BLOB theme compression constants (e.g. Compact/Fast/GZIP Best/GZIP Fast, or 0 for not compressed) -- see the BLOB theme constants for the exact value/meaning mapping.

overloadMerges.note: compressed, expandedSize and currentSize are all documented/arrow-marked as outputs ('<-', filled by the command), not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in.

params.name: compressed
params.description: Compression mode/status of the BLOB (a BLOB-theme compression constant, or 0 if not compressed).

params.name: expandedSize
params.description: Size of the BLOB in bytes when not compressed.

params.name: currentSize
params.description: Current (possibly compressed) size of the BLOB in bytes.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills compressed (and, if requested, expandedSize/currentSize) with information about how blob is currently compressed and its size(s).
